protocol.status: specified before the first application benchmark run
protocol.selection: validation only, refit selected model on train+validation; nine candidates per learned family
protocol.pooled_control: classical_selected chooses a conventional model family using validation only, pooling 45 regression or 27 classification candidates; physics-informed and Bayes controls remain separate
protocol.reporting: keep every configuration, warning, failed candidate and test prediction; do not drop unfavorable cells
protocol.paired_gain_rule: descriptive paired seed-bootstrap lower endpoint > 0; at least 8/10 positive seeds; not a multiple-comparison significance claim
protocol.claim_boundary: simulated application prototypes; no observed hardware speedup or production benefit

limits: No hardware runs or computational speedup. Periodic task has an identical cheap classical representation. Quantum-state task compares acquisition protocols, not the power of regularization; general POVM lower bounds belong to the cited paper, not this finite simulation. All cells are retained; intervals are descriptive, uncorrected for multiple comparisons.
